hotels.title: Malaysia Five-Star Oceanfront Escape with Private Pool Suites
hotels.description: Discover the pinnacle of tropical luxury with an escape to five-star Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast, a spectacular retreat perched on the southeastern shore of Malaysia, nestled between verdant rainforests and the pristine South China Sea. Spend your days luxuriating on the white sands of Desaru Beach, lounging by the elegant infinity pool while you indulge in a superb meal at the poolside Essential café. Toast to your stay at Dusty Monkey bar, where regional rums, curated gins, fine whiskies, artisanal tonics and house cocktails are guaranteed to delight. An array of watersport activities can be organised onsite for the entire family - while the children are entertained at the complimentary kids' club, adults might like to treat themselves at the onsite Chenot Spa or tempt their tastebuds with an omakase menu of fresh seafood at Hoshi restaurant.
